name: K9_Bench_rephrased
description: A rephrased version of the K9 benchmark intended to measure language models' robustness to paraphrasing and their ability to answer reworded questions. It evaluates consistency and factual/reasoning performance when prompts are presented in varied surface forms. Useful for assessing paraphrase robustness and general QA performance.
reputation: A small, specialized HuggingFace dataset with limited community adoption outside its originating group.
